items.name: chat-input
items.title: Chat input
items.description: Rounded AI prompt box with attach tools, a round send button and a shimmering "Searching the web" status below.

items.name: task-checklist
items.title: Task checklist
items.description: Collapsible to-do list for an AI agent: each step fills a progress ring, rolls its percentage and strikes through when done.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: Collapsible block for model reasoning: open with a live timer and shimmering label while the model thinks, then folded into "Thought for Ns". Takes AI SDK reasoning parts.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool call
items.description: Collapsible card for one AI agent tool call: the arguments stream in, a status pill shimmers while it runs, then the result slides in. Takes a Vercel AI SDK tool part as is.

items.name: terminal-output
items.title: Terminal Output
items.description: A command the agent ran: live output with stderr marked, exit code, run time, copy and stop.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model picker
items.description: A composer pill that switches models from a grouped list, with a reasoning-effort toggle for models that think.

items.name: tool-approval
items.title: Tool approval
items.description: Inline card that asks the user before an AI agent runs a tool with side effects: the question, the tool name, its arguments as rows, and Approve / Deny buttons that settle into an approved or denied line.

items.name: error-retry
items.title: Error & Retry
items.description: An agent error people can act on: what failed, a countdown to the next automatic retry, Retry now and the raw details.

items.name: attachments
items.title: Attachments
items.description: File chips for a chat composer: drop, paste or pick files, with image thumbnails, upload progress, error chips and remove.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: Agent answer with inline citation chips that show the source on hover, and a collapsible list of the sources behind it. Reads [1]-style markers and AI SDK source-url parts.

items.name: agent-timeline
items.title: Agent timeline
items.description: Vertical log of what an AI agent did, one row per step: an icon for the kind of step (think, search, read, tool, write), the title, a detail line, live running state and a done summary.

items.name: context-meter
items.title: Context meter
items.description: How full the model's context window is: a ring that opens into a per-source token breakdown, with a Compact action near the limit.

items.name: artifact-panel
items.title: Artifact panel
items.description: Side panel for what an AI agent made: Preview and Code tabs, a version switcher with a note per version, copy, and code that streams in while the agent writes.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message actions
items.description: The row under an assistant message: copy, regenerate, thumbs up or down with a reason, and a switcher between regenerated answers.

items.name: streaming-message
items.title: Streaming message
items.description: Assistant message that streams in word by word with a soft fade, light markdown (bold, inline code, lists, fenced code), code blocks that hold their frame while code arrives, a Stop button while streaming and Copy / Regenerate when done.

items.name: sub-agents
items.title: Sub-agents
items.description: Parallel sub-agents under one task: a lane per agent with its live step, status, run time and tool calls, opening into its result.

items.name: diff-viewer
items.title: Diff Viewer
items.description: Review an agent's file edits: a card per file with +/- counts, line numbers, and Accept or Reject on each hunk.

items.name: conversation-shell
items.title: Conversation shell
items.description: App frame for an AI agent chat: a top bar with breadcrumb, search and Ask AI over a chat panel, a message list that sticks to the newest message while it streams, a jump-to-latest button once you scroll up, an empty state with suggestions, and a growing composer with Send / Stop.

items.name: agent-question
items.title: Agent question
items.description: Inline card for when an AI agent stops to ask the user something: the question and why, choices with descriptions (one or several), a field for another answer, number-key shortcuts, then a settled 'You answered' line. Answers a client-side ask tool with the Vercel AI SDK.

items.name: plan-review
items.title: Plan Review
items.description: The agent's plan before it runs: edit, reorder, remove or add steps, then approve or ask for changes.

items.name: voice-agent
items.title: Voice agent
items.description: Voice assistant card with a cube outline made of particles that shake like sound while the call is live, and a Start talking / End call button.

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice orb
items.description: Voice assistant card with a swirling sphere of particles, each with its own speed and size, that surge out from the centre and back while the call is live, and a Start talking / End call button.

items.name: thinking-ring
items.title: Thinking ring
items.description: Thinking indicator: a wobbling dot ring and a shimmering label.

items.name: thinking-wave
items.title: Thinking wave
items.description: Thinking indicator: a breathing wave orb and a shimmering label.

items.name: thinking-sparkle
items.title: Thinking sparkle
items.description: AI thinking status with a monochrome sparkling diamond and shimmering text.

items.name: thinking-bot
items.title: Thinking bot
items.description: AI thinking status with a sleek android helmet whose visor bars bounce like a voice meter beside shimmering text.

items.name: prompt-deck
items.title: Prompt deck
items.description: A stack of prompt cards that swipes the front card away and lifts the next one into place, on a loop while it is on screen.

items.name: contact-stack
items.title: Contact stack
items.description: A stack of contact cards with pastel icon circles: the front card drops away and tucks behind the rest, on a loop while it is on screen.

items.name: service-receipt
items.title: Service receipt
items.description: A light ticket-style receipt with notched edges, dashed tear lines and a scalloped bottom: tick service lines and the amount adds up before starting the project.

items.name: revenue-card
items.title: Revenue card
items.description: A light analytics card for monthly revenue: stat numbers count up as a month-to-date chart draws in, with a goal share, a trend versus last month and a hatched channel bar with a dot legend.

items.name: swipe-deck
items.title: Swipe deck
items.description: A deck of soft social carousel posts with an inner panel, a visual, a page index and a like, comment, share and bookmark row: the front card swings out to the left as the next one steps up, by timer, swipe or arrows.

items.name: story-testimonial
items.title: Story testimonial
items.description: A white testimonial card with an avatar, name, handle, serif quote and date that plays like a story: the active bar along the bottom fills, then the next quote fades in. Tap either side to step back or forward.

items.name: icon-buttons
items.title: Icon buttons
items.description: Secondary, outline and destructive buttons with soft status buttons and animated icons, popping in as one group.

items.name: qr-badge
items.title: QR badge
items.description: A QR code that dissolves into sand, pours into a scan badge and grows back.

items.name: labeled-input
items.title: Labeled input
items.description: Email input with a label and helper text.

items.name: subscribe-input
items.title: Subscribe input
items.description: Newsletter-style input with a leading icon and submit button.

items.name: marquee-card
items.title: Marquee card
items.description: Feature card with rows of style tags drifting in alternating directions behind faded edges, above a short headline.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar group
items.description: Stacked avatars with an overflow count.

items.name: settings-list
items.title: Settings list
items.description: Notification settings list with switches.

items.name: price-badge
items.title: Price badge
items.description: Pill badge that rolls between prices glyph by glyph, resizing smoothly as it goes.

items.name: flip-clock
items.title: Flip clock
items.description: A grain-textured dark minutes-and-seconds flip clock with a split-flap fold animation that shows local time or counts down to a target date.

items.name: heart-rate-card
items.title: Heart rate card
items.description: Minimal heart-rate summary with a segmented range indicator and weekly and monthly averages.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: Password input with show/hide toggle and a live strength checklist.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP input
items.description: Six-digit OTP input with paste, backspace and arrow-key support.

items.name: waitlist
items.title: Waitlist
items.description: Email signup with a live avatar stack: new people slide in, the last one tucks under a rolling join counter.

items.name: animated-metrics-card
items.title: Animated metrics card
items.description: A weekly productivity card with colorful deep-work, task, streak and project metrics scrolling in a seamless loop.

items.name: folder-card
items.title: Folder card
items.description: Folder that opens on hover and fans out the files inside.

items.name: celebration-card
items.title: Celebration card
items.description: Task bubbles rain down, pile up on the headline and drain away when you switch range.

items.name: pdf-stack
items.title: PDF stack
items.description: A file card with paper sheets and tilted profile cards behind it that rise in on enter and fan out on hover.

items.name: avatar-status
items.title: Avatar status
items.description: Team list with online, away and offline status dots.

items.name: alerts
items.title: Alerts
items.description: Info, success, warning and error alerts with dismiss buttons.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: Drop zone that grows as files land, with per-file progress, errors and retry.

items.name: waitlist-pass
items.title: Waitlist pass
items.description: Ticket-style waitlist pass with notched edges, a QR code stub and a tilt-and-glare hover.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Accessible accordion built on details and summary.

items.name: shortcuts
items.title: Shortcuts
items.description: Shortcut list with styled key caps.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Dashed empty state with a skeleton-card illustration, copy and two actions.

items.name: agent-chat
items.title: Agent chat
items.description: AI assistant thread that types a request, thinks over a sparkle field, asks a follow-up with a select and choice tiles, then streams its answer word by word.

items.name: hero-pill
items.title: Pill hero
items.description: Centered hero with a crew of bobbing agent avatars and a headline pill that wipes between words and colours. Respects reduced motion.

items.name: hero-grid
items.title: Grid hero
items.description: Centered hero on a square grid where integration icons blink in and out, paused while off screen.

items.name: moodboard-generator
items.title: Moodboard generator
items.description: Choose from four modern visual directions to kick off a creative moodboard.

items.name: usage-card
items.title: Usage card
items.description: Animated credit usage card with period tabs, stacked breakdown, daily chart and plan limits.

items.name: design-results
items.title: Design results
items.description: Dark agency mission and results section with staggered entrance animations and a tilted client satisfaction card.

items.name: pricing-tiers
items.title: Pricing tiers
items.description: Three plans with a monthly/annual toggle, usage chips and a framed recommended tier.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Three testimonial cards with ratings and avatars.

items.name: hero-waitlist
items.title: Waitlist hero
items.description: Hero with email capture and avatar social proof.

items.name: intro-banner
items.title: Intro banner
items.description: A playful typographic hero with a staggered word-and-emoji entrance animation.

items.name: creative-home-hero
items.title: Creative home hero
items.description: Creator-style homepage hero with an expressive robot and a cycling typewriter headline.

items.name: hero-chat
items.title: Chat hero
items.description: AI hero with a polished chatbox whose placeholder types out questions, ringed by app icons orbiting on dashed circles. Paused while off screen.

items.name: app-shelf
items.title: App shelf
items.description: Row of glossy app icons where hovering one bounces a mock preview out of it, with name, blurb and button, while the rest of the page softens into a blur.

items.name: dashboard-home
items.title: Dashboard home
items.description: Dashboard start page with today's counts, an AI search bar, quick actions and revenue and target cards.

items.name: leads-table
items.title: Leads table
items.description: CRM leads table with click-to-sort columns, filter dropdowns for date, owner, status and payment, search, row selection and pagination. Rows cascade in and deal values count up when it scrolls into view.

items.name: ascii-workspace
items.title: ASCII workspace
items.description: Full-viewport agent app start screen: sidebar, prompt box and task cards. The pointer uncovers ASCII glyphs that fade toward the edge of its lens; clicking empty space drops a ripple of glyphs that spreads like water.

items.name: research-agent
items.title: Research agent
items.description: Full agent app built from the 8 agent primitives: the agent thinks, searches and reads your workspace on a live activity timeline, writes a memo into a side panel, answers with citations, then asks before it shares the memo. Scripted end to end, so it runs with no backend until you plug in your model.

items.name: support-agent
items.title: Support agent
items.description: Support inbox with an AI copilot, built from the agent primitives: open a ticket and the agent reads it, looks up the customer, searches the help center on a live activity timeline, drafts a reply with citations and asks before it issues a refund. Ticket list, customer panel and a send step included. Scripted end to end, so it runs with no backend until you plug in your model.

items.name: coding-agent
items.title: Coding agent
items.description: Coding agent app built from the agent primitives: the agent reads the code, reproduces the bug with a failing test, edits the file and shows the diff, runs the tests green and asks before it opens a pull request. A side panel holds the file before and after, each with a live preview. Scripted end to end, so it runs with no backend until you plug in your model.

items.name: quote
items.title: Quote
items.description: One large testimonial with author.

items.name: team
items.title: Team
items.description: Staggered speaker cards on one warm backdrop with a champagne keynote card, scroll-in and hover motion.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign in
items.description: Sign-in card in a soft frame: GitHub and Google buttons, email and password with a show toggle, remember me and a sign-up footer.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text reveal
items.description: Words that arrive one at a time, fading in out of a soft blur as they rise into place.

items.name: perspective-text-swap
items.title: Perspective text swap
items.description: Replaces one phrase with another in a soft, perspective-driven 3D turn.

items.name: text-highlight
items.title: Text highlight
items.description: An inline marker that sweeps behind a key phrase once it scrolls into view.

items.name: sound-ring
items.title: Sound ring
items.description: A ring of rounded bars that jumps like an audio visualizer, each beat lifting a cluster of bars into a peak.

items.name: globe-arcs
items.title: Globe arcs
items.description: A dotted globe with arcs that draw between cities; drag to turn it, or click a city to bring it to the front.

items.name: sale-stamp
items.title: Sale stamp
items.description: A red sale seal with orbiting promotional text and a fixed center label.

items.name: crm-overview
items.title: CRM overview
items.description: CRM start page: stat cards that count up, a pipeline funnel and lead trend, a live knowledge graph with five layouts (galaxy, cosmos, grid, orbit, radial), to-dos, agent runs and the next 14 days.

items.name: developer-portfolio
items.title: Developer portfolio
items.description: One-page portfolio for a developer: animated grid hero with a waving avatar, bento cards (experience, live terminal, reading, location, work steps), about, a staggered projects grid with a particle globe, videos, subscribe and a footer with a giant handle.

items.name: particle-landing
items.title: Particle landing
items.description: Dark landing page for an AI assistant with a particle cloud that follows the scroll: a meshed sphere rises behind the hero, slides aside, folds into a ring around a chat, flattens into a wave, scatters into stars and gathers back for the closing call to action.

items.name: particle-story
items.title: Particle story
items.description: A dark-and-gold atelier landing page where thousands of particles break apart and rebuild into each section's shape on scroll: Saturn, phone, laptop, monitor, globe, network, tablets, dial and crystals, with an editorial header, dot rail and full footer.

items.name: statement-converter
items.title: Statement converter
items.description: Deep-green bank-statement-to-CSV LP featuring live PDF parsing demo, scroll manifesto, bank grid, step rows, comparison table, draggable reviews & local clock.

items.name: ai-photo-studio
items.title: AI photo studio
items.description: Dark navy/indigo AI photo LP with pink-orange accents & auto-typing brief. Interactive: unblurring takes, handwritten notes, auto-Kanban, seed-lock & code card. Complete with stats, lighting chips, spotlight grid, reviews, pricing & FAQ.

items.name: group-card-launch
items.title: Group card launch
items.description: Bright fintech launch-event LP for a shared group card. Motion: 3D card coverflow, chunky multicolour number that drops in with confetti, sticker shapes popping on scroll, live split feed, perk progress meters, flip countdown & share burst. Built from geometric shapes, no illustrations.

items.name: marketing-dashboard
items.title: Marketing dashboard
items.description: Full-width marketing dashboard with a sidebar: lead split bar, channel clicks by month, goal tick meters, a daily traffic line with the previous period, a conversion funnel, a weekly campaign calendar and a campaign table grouped by channel. Motion: sidebar and cards sharpen in from a blur one by one, numbers count up, bars grow, the traffic line draws itself, and a notification panel slides in with filter tabs while the page blurs behind it.

items.name: month-end-story
items.title: Month-end story
items.description: Scroll-told story LP for an AI month-end close service. Motion: pinned chapters with captions that light up word by word, a memo typing itself out of redaction bars, hours and days ticking up, a busywork bar flipping to judgment, roles stepping forward, a folder unfolding into a live checklist, scattered steps snapping into a pipeline, clock vs seal finale. Built from CSS shapes and icons, no illustrations.

items.name: sleep-bars
items.title: Sleep bars
items.description: A week of sleep as columns of lights, one light per hour, with a dashed goal line. Click or arrow through the nights to pick one and see its hours, bedtime and how far it sits from the goal.

items.name: flip-text
items.title: Flip text
items.description: Text whose letters roll forward like little cubes, one after another in a wave that loops without a seam.

items.name: the-shift
items.title: The shift
items.description: Chapter 03 of the Month-end story as its own scene: a giant caption lights up word by word while a bar of busywork flips, block by block, into judgment and the percentages tick across. Plays itself when it scrolls into view, or follows a progress value you pass, such as scroll.

items.name: launch-perks
items.title: Launch perks
items.description: The perks section from the Group card launch page as its own block: a heading with a live countdown to the end of the offer, then three tinted perk cards where the emoji bob, the claimed count tweens up and the bar fills as crews join.

items.name: task-hub
items.title: Task Hub
items.description: Playful team workspace and CRM landing page with an interactive leads table, pastel bento cards, autonomous sprint checklist, and 3D momentum conveyor.

items.name: global-media
items.title: Global Media
items.description: Dark editorial landing page for a global media group: a draggable 3D dotted globe that turns to each bureau, kinetic condensed headlines, a divisions index, a live bureau map with local clocks, a campaign reach planner and a newsroom.

items.name: hexora-ecosystem
items.title: Hexora ecosystem
items.description: Dark editorial landing page for an ecosystem partner studio: a condensed poster headline on a hairline grid, a hexagon plate you click to switch pillars (leader lines draw to each capability), drifting ember particles, a scroll-driven kinetic line, three sticky steps whose visuals swap on scroll, and a manifesto written on scroll-drawn ribbons.

items.name: mcp-servers
items.title: MCP servers
items.description: Manage Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers connected to an AI agent: connection status, OAuth reconnect, and an expandable tool drawer with per-tool switches and call counts.

items.name: browser-agent
items.title: Browser agent
items.description: Headless browser viewport for a computer-use AI agent: live address bar, animated agent cursor with click ripples, step progress dots, and a Take over button for manual human input.

items.name: staged-action
items.title: Staged action
items.description: Human-in-the-loop staged action card: pre-filled fields grounded in agent context that the user can edit inline before clicking Approve or Discard.

items.name: agent-memory
items.title: Agent memory
items.description: Inline 'Updated memory' pill that expands into a persistent memory drawer: inspect workspace rules and user preferences learned by the agent, add new rules, or forget entries.

items.name: mention-picker
items.title: Mention picker
items.description: Context mention popover for an AI prompt composer: type @ to filter and attach files, symbols, git diffs, docs or web pages with keyboard navigation and live token estimates.

items.name: sql-query-card
items.title: SQL query card
items.description: Database query execution card for a data or coding agent: switch between the tabular result rows and the raw SQL statement, with row count, run time and one-click CSV/SQL copy.

items.name: secret-request
items.title: Secret request
items.description: Inline card that collects an API key or environment variable out-of-band: masked password input, reveal toggle, prefix check, target .env file badge and settled saved state.

items.name: slash-commands
items.title: Slash commands
items.description: Skill and workflow command palette triggered by typing / in an AI composer: filter /plan, /review, /compact, /test and /pr with keyboard navigation and argument hints.

items.name: cost-tracker
items.title: Cost tracker
items.description: Real-time token, throughput, prompt-cache hit rate and USD cost telemetry for a multi-step agent run, opening into a per-step model breakdown.

items.name: agent-handoff
items.title: Agent handoff
items.description: Specialist transfer card showing when a router agent hands conversation control to a domain specialist, with an expandable summary of the transferred context.

items.name: scheduled-trigger
items.title: Scheduled trigger
items.description: Recurring background agent card with human-readable schedule, cron badge, recent run history, Pause/Resume toggle and a Run now button.

items.name: guardrail-check
items.title: Guardrail check
items.description: Safety and policy verification card showing PII masking, prompt-injection screening and role/spend boundary checks before an agent executes.

items.name: model-arena
items.title: Model arena
items.description: Side-by-side model response comparison card with per-model latency, cost telemetry and one-click preference voting.

items.name: sandbox-preview
items.title: Sandbox preview
items.description: Embedded dev-server port preview frame for a coding agent: live localhost address bar, Desktop/Mobile viewport toggle, reload button and HMR console drawer.

items.name: checkpoint-rewind
items.title: Checkpoint rewind
items.description: Session timeline with restore points: pick a checkpoint, preview the files that will revert, and rewind code or code and chat while HEAD glides back.

items.name: trace-waterfall
items.title: Trace waterfall
items.description: Live span waterfall for an agent run with LLM, tool, retrieval and sub-agent bars on one timeline, a moving playhead, error spans and a per-span detail panel.

items.name: background-tasks
items.title: Background tasks
items.description: Queue of long-running agent jobs with live progress bars, ETA, cancel and retry, an overall progress ring and a completion toast.

items.name: rag-retrieval
items.title: RAG retrieval
items.description: Retrieved chunks for a RAG answer with similarity scores, sources, highlighted matches and per-chunk switches to re-run the answer.

items.name: oauth-consent
items.title: OAuth consent
items.description: Permission card for connecting an agent to an app: scopes with risk levels, optional trims, and an animated connect handshake.
